lines.en: label streets30:
scene wherethesidewalkends1
{i}There is a place where the sidewalk ends{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有一个地方，人行道的尽头{/i}

lines.en: {i}And before the street begins,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在街道开始之前，{/i}

lines.en: {i}And there the grass grows soft and white,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那里的草长得柔软又洁白，{/i}

lines.en: {i}And there the sun burns crimson bright,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那里的太阳燃得鲜红明亮，{/i}

lines.en: {i}And there the moon-bird rests from his flight{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那里的月亮鸟停下飞翔的旅程，{/i}

lines.en: {i}To cool in the peppermint wind{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在薄荷的风里歇凉。{/i}

lines.en: These are the words of Shel Silverstein, acclaimed children’s writer and poet.
lines.zh: 这是 Shel Silverstein 的诗句，他是备受赞誉的儿童文学作家兼诗人。

lines.en: Let us think for a moment.
lines.zh: 让我们思考片刻。

lines.en: What if, by some stretch of the imagination, there {i}was{/i} a place where the sidewalk ended?
lines.zh: 假如，稍微发挥一点想象力，{i}真的{/i}“存在”一个人行道尽头的地方呢？

lines.en: And, for the sake of the argument, let’s say the street ended there too.
lines.zh: 而且，为了论证起见，就假设街道也在那里一并结束。

lines.en: What do you think would happen if you were to just walk off the edge?
lines.zh: 那么你要是一脚走下边缘，你觉得会发生什么？

lines.en: How long would you fall for?
lines.zh: 你会坠落多久？

lines.en: Would it be for the rest of eternity?
lines.zh: 是永无止境吗？

lines.en: Or would there be somewhere at the bottom where you could land?
lines.zh: 还是说底下有某个能让你落地的地方？

lines.en: I’ve heard stories in the past about how people falling from buildings tend to die before ever hitting the ground.
lines.zh: 我以前听过一些说法，说从楼上掉下来的人往往在撞到地面之前就死了。

lines.en: Or at least they faint or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 或者至少会昏过去之类的。

lines.en: But, for anyone insane enough to stare death in the eyes and say “Sure, take me if you want-”
lines.zh: 不过，对于那些疯狂到敢直视死亡的眼睛、说出“行啊，想带走我就带走吧——”的人，

lines.en: I wonder what that collision with the ground would feel like.
lines.zh: 我很好奇撞上地面的那一刻会是什么感觉。

lines.en: I can’t imagine it would be very good.
lines.zh: 我想那大概不会太好受。

lines.en: If for some reason, though, you managed to survive the impact and a friendly passerby helped push your bones back into your body-
lines.zh: 但如果出于某种原因，你扛过了撞击，还有个好心的路人帮忙把骨头塞回你的身体里——

lines.en: What is it that you’d want to see there?
lines.zh: 那你到了那里，会想看见什么？

lines.en: This entire scenario is hypothetical, so it could really be anything you’d wish for.
lines.zh: 整个假设都是虚构的，所以它可以真的是你许愿的任何东西。

lines.en: I mean, you {i}did{/i} walk off the edge after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟，你“{i}确实{/i}”是自己走下边缘的。

lines.en: So there must be {i}something{/i} you were hoping to achieve or...find.
lines.zh: 所以一定有“{i}什么{/i}”是你希望达成的，或者……找到的。

lines.en: Or feel.
lines.zh: 或者感受到的。

lines.en: Now, I’m not saying Shel Silverstein’s works are meant to convince children that it’s okay to jump to their deaths.
lines.zh: 现在，我并不是说 Shel Silverstein 的作品是为了说服孩子们跳楼自杀也没关系。

lines.en: It’s not.
lines.zh: 不是的。

lines.en: But poetry is something where we’re meant to interpret our own meanings and come to our own conclusions.
lines.zh: 但诗歌这种东西，本就该由我们自己去解读含义、得出自己的结论。

lines.en: Oh, and the very next line of that poem is “Let us leave this place where the smoke blows black.”
lines.zh: 哦，还有那首诗的下一句就是“让我们离开这黑烟弥漫的地方。”

lines.en: So, yeah.
lines.zh: 所以，没错。

lines.en: Anyway, the sidewalk probably does end somewhere.
lines.zh: 总之，人行道大概确实会在某个地方结束。

lines.en: The street, too.
lines.zh: 街道也是。

lines.en: But the likelihood of there being anything beneath it-
lines.zh: 但它下面存在什么东西的可能性——

lines.en: A place where your legs could shoot through your upper body if you landed at the perfect angle-
lines.zh: 一个只要你落地角度够完美、双腿就会从上半身穿出去的地方——

lines.en: The likelihood of something like that simply does not exist.
lines.zh: 那种东西存在的可能性根本就不成立。

lines.en: But you do.
lines.zh: 可你存在。

lines.en: Or do you?
lines.zh: 还是说，你并不存在？

lines.en: And if you don’t-
lines.zh: 如果你不存在——

lines.en: : What the absolute fuck are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底在干什么？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends2
: Oh, Yumi. Hey.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi。嘿。

lines.en: : The fuck do you mean, “Oh, Yumi, Hey?”
lines.zh: : 你他妈“哦，Yumi，嘿”是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’ve been watching you just...standing there staring into a tunnel for like five minutes now.
lines.zh: : 我已经看着你……干站在这儿盯着一条隧道看了五分钟了。

lines.en: : You on drugs or something?
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Not that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。

lines.en: : I’m not the only one acting out of character, though.
lines.zh: : 不过也不止我一个人反常。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends3
: The fuck is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 这他妈什么意思？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : It might sound a little weird, but I never really pictured you as the type to buy ice cream.
lines.zh: : 可能听起来有点怪，但我从没想过你会是那种买冰淇淋的人。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends4
: What kind of fucking person do you think I am?! Everyone likes ice cream!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我他妈是哪种人？！谁都喜欢冰淇淋！

lines.en: : Can you even afford it?
lines.zh: : 你买得起吗？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends5
: You know what? Just go back to standing in the middle of the street.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？你还是回去站在马路中间吧。

lines.en: : If you get hit by a car, though-
lines.zh: : 不过你要是被车撞了——

lines.en: : You shouldn’t talk about people being hit by cars.
lines.zh: : 你不该拿别人被车撞这种事开玩笑。

lines.en: : And you shouldn’t make fun of girls for being poor and eating ice cream, asshole.
lines.zh: : 那你也不该嘲笑一个又穷又吃冰淇淋的女生，混蛋。

lines.en: : You’re right. I humbly apologize.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我诚心道歉。

lines.en: : Yumi, please allow me to purchase you a frozen dessert.
lines.zh: : Yumi，请允许我为你买一份冷冻甜点。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends6
: Alternative option- how about you leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 换个选项——你离我远点怎么样？

lines.en: : You’re the one who called out to me, remember? You could have just let me stand there.
lines.zh: : 是你先叫住我的，记得吗？你完全可以让我继续站着。

lines.en: : You’re right. I could have.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我本来可以。

lines.en: : So why didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么没有？

lines.en: : Beats me. I’m probably just getting used to seeing you wandering around like you’re in a fuckin’ trance or something.
lines.zh: : 鬼知道。我大概是习惯了看你像中了邪似的到处晃悠。

lines.en: : You know my mom now, right? That alone increases your chances of becoming a junkie by like...fifty.
lines.zh: : 你现在认识我妈了吧？光这一点，你变成瘾君子的概率就提高了大概……五十。

lines.en: Now that she mentions it, Yumi {i}does{/i} seem to be around pretty frequently during whatever those...momentary lapses of judgement I have are.
lines.zh: 她这么一说，在我那些……短暂的判断失灵的时刻，Yumi“{i}确实{/i}”出现得相当频繁。

lines.en: I look back to where the sidewalk ends to find that it doesn’t end at all.
lines.zh: 我回头看向人行道尽头的那个地方，却发现它根本没有尽头。

lines.en: It’s just as she said- a tunnel.
lines.zh: 正如她所说——那只是条隧道。

lines.en: So then why did I see it as something so much different?
lines.zh: 那么，为什么我刚才把它看成了截然不同的东西？

lines.en: : What? Now you’re gonna get all quiet?
lines.zh: : 什么？你现在又要装哑巴了？

lines.en: : Forget I said anything. Just go and fucking-
lines.zh: : 当我什么都没说。你他妈给我继续——

lines.en: : Yumi, do you have any supernatural powers?
lines.zh: : Yumi，你有超自然能力吗？

lines.en: : Like changing people’s perception of things or...resetting the world?
lines.zh: : 比如改变别人对事物的感知，或者……重置世界？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends7
: Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : Interesting. That’s not a “no.”
lines.zh: : 有意思。这可不算“没有”。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends8
: It fucking {i}is{/i} a no! Of course I don’t have magical powers! I’m not fuckin’ Sailor Moon or some shit!
lines.zh: : 这他妈“{i}就是{/i}”没有！我当然没有什么魔法！我又不是美少女战士什么的！

lines.en: : Then stop showing up whenever my brain starts short circuiting.
lines.zh: : 那别再每次我脑子短路的时候就冒出来了。

lines.en: : Get a new fucking brain! The one you have sucks anyway!
lines.zh: : 去换个新脑子吧！你现在这个反正也烂透了！

lines.en: : Also, aren’t {i}you{/i} the one who decided to come here?!
lines.zh: : 而且，“{i}你{/i}”才是决定跑到这儿来的人吧？！

lines.en: : You know I wander around during the afternoons and it {i}definitely{/i} doesn’t look like you’re going anywhere important right now.
lines.zh: : 你知道我下午都在外面晃，而且{i}“显然”{/i}看不出来你现在有什么要紧的地方要去。

lines.en: : Huh. Actually, I think you’re right.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这么一说，你倒是说对了。

lines.en: : I was hoping to find you today.
lines.zh: : 我今天本来就想找你。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends9
: Wow. Shocker. When has that ever happened before?
lines.zh: : 哇。真让人震惊。这种事以前什么时候发生过？

lines.en: : So...what do you want?
lines.zh: : 那么……你想干什么？

lines.en: : You found me. I’m not running away. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你找到我了。我又没跑。你想干什么？

lines.en: : Just to hang out I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是一起玩玩吧。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends10
: Why? Aren’t you supposed to be at a fucking hot spring with Chika right now or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你现在不是该跟 Chika 在什么温泉里吗？

lines.en: : She told you about that?
lines.zh: : 她跟你说了？

lines.en: : Of course she fucking told me about that. We live together.
lines.zh: : 她当然他妈跟我说了。我们住在一起。

lines.en: : She never fucking shuts up about you. It’s going to drive me insane one of these days.
lines.zh: : 她一天到晚说你，没完没了。迟早有一天会把我逼疯。

lines.en: : Also, can I buy my fucking ice cream already? I didn’t realize you were going to take this long to finish whatever you’re trying to say.
lines.zh: : 还有，我能不能先把我那份该死的冰淇淋买了？我不知道你讲完你想说的话要这么久。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Are you sure you can afford it, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你确定买得起吗？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends4
: Yes! I can fucking afford 200 yen for ice cream!
lines.zh: : 买得起！我他妈买 200 日元的冰淇淋还是买得起的！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi presses a button on the machine, leaving the two of us to wait in suspense/silence for the roughly ten seconds it takes for the claw to work its magic.
lines.zh: Yumi 按下机器上的按钮，接下来我们两个就在悬念与沉默中，等着那台夹子施展它的魔法，大约十秒钟。

lines.en: The ice cream jumps to its death.
lines.zh: 冰淇淋纵身一跃，摔死了。

lines.en: She peels the wrapper off and tosses it into a trash can.
lines.zh: 她撕开包装纸，把它扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: I feel like if this were several months ago, she would have intentionally gone out of her way to drop it on the ground {i}beside{/i} the trash can.
lines.zh: 我觉得要是换作几个月前，她一定会故意绕远，把它丢在垃圾桶{i}“旁边”{/i}的地上。

lines.en: That could just be me not giving her enough credit.
lines.zh: 也可能只是我没有给她足够的信任。

lines.en: But I would like to attribute her newfound instinct to throw away garbage to myself, as I have clearly made an impact on her somehow.
lines.zh: 但我更愿意把她新学会把垃圾扔掉的本能归功于自己，因为我显然以某种方式影响了她。

lines.en: Yumi has been fixed.
lines.zh: Yumi 已经被修好了。

lines.en: I can now fade away into nothingness.
lines.zh: 现在我可以消失在虚无之中了。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends11
: Why are you sitting down?
lines.zh: : 你为什么坐下了？

lines.en: : Because we weren’t done talking yet.
lines.zh: : 因为我们还没聊完。

lines.en: : Okay, better question- why are you just staring at me like that? I can’t fucking eat with you watching me.
lines.zh: : 好，换个更好的问题——你为什么就这么盯着我看？你看着我我他妈吃不下。

lines.en: : Lick the ice cream, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 舔那根冰淇淋，Yumi。

lines.en: : {i}Lick it.{/i}
scene wherethesidewalkends12
: Jesus fucking Christ, you’re such a creep!
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的，你真是个变态！

lines.en: : I’m sorry. It’s just so out of character. I can’t help myself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是太不像你了。我忍不住。

lines.en: : How is eating ice cream out of character?! I’m hungry and ice cream is good!
lines.zh: : 吃冰淇淋哪里不像我了？！我饿了，而且冰淇淋很好吃！

lines.en: : It’s also freezing out. Everything about this situation is exceedingly strange.
lines.zh: : 可外面还冷得要死。这一切都异常得离谱。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends13
: Yeah, I don’t think the dude who was standing still for five minutes and staring into an abyss has the authority to talk about what’s “strange.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得一个干站五分钟盯着深渊看的人，没资格谈论什么叫“异常”。

lines.en: : That part was strange, too. Everything about this event is strange.
lines.zh: : 那部分也很异常。这整个事件的一切都很异常。

lines.en: : Event? The fuck are you on about now?
lines.zh: : 事件？你他妈又在胡扯什么？

lines.en: : Never mind that. How are things?
lines.zh: : 那个不重要。最近怎么样？

lines.en: : {i}How are things?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}“最近怎么样？”{/i}

lines.en: : Are we really just going to talk like normal people who like each other?
lines.zh: : 我们真的要像两个互相喜欢的正常人那样聊天了吗？

lines.en: : No “Yumi Revitalization Project” or “Stop calling Futaba fat” shit today?
lines.zh: : 今天没有“Yumi 改造计划”或者“别再叫 Futaba 胖子”之类的破事了？

lines.en: : I mean, I wanted to talk about whatever the magical powers you’re hiding from me are, but you seem pretty against that.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我本来想聊聊你瞒着我的魔法能力，不过你似乎很抵触。

lines.en: : I’m pretty against talking to you in general.
lines.zh: : 我抵触的是跟你说话这件事本身。

lines.en: : Then I’ll just sit here and watch you eat your ice cream.
lines.zh: : 那我就坐在这儿看你吃冰淇淋好了。

lines.en: : That’s somehow even worse.
lines.zh: : 那反而更糟。

lines.en: : Then say something.
lines.zh: : 那就说点什么吧。

lines.en: : Say what?
lines.zh: : 说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : What are you going to be doing while Chika and I are at the hot spring?
lines.zh: : 我和 Chika 去温泉的时候，你打算干什么？

lines.en: : Babysitting.
lines.zh: : 带孩子。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Chinami can’t be alone for that long.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Chinami 不能一个人待那么久。

lines.en: : I mean, she could. But she probably shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我是说，她能。但她大概不该。

lines.en: : Twerp is surprisingly independent for someone who can’t even do long division yet.
lines.zh: : 小不点明明连长除法都还不会，却独立得出奇。

lines.en: : Can you do long division, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你会长除法吗，Yumi？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends14
: I’m in fucking [high_school], aren’t I?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈可是上[high_school]的，不是吗？！

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，并没有。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends15
: Yeah, well...maybe if my teacher wasn’t so dead set on getting into my pants, I’d want to come more.
lines.zh: : 哼，好吧……也许要是我的老师不是一心只想钻进我的裤子里，我会更想去上课。

lines.en: : Oh, and you can’t make that stupid “You’re not even wearing pants” joke you made that one time because I actually {i}am{/i} wearing pants now.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你那次“你根本没穿裤子”的烂梗这回不能用了，因为我现在“{i}确实{/i}”穿着裤子。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you still think I’m trying to do that with you.
lines.zh: : 你还觉得我想对你做那种事，真让我意外。

lines.en: : I haven’t even touched you since-
lines.zh: : 我从那之后都没碰过你——

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends16
: Nope. Gonna stop you right there.
lines.zh: : 不。我在这儿打断你。

lines.en: : Told myself I’d move past that. And that’s gonna be really fuckin’ hard to do if you start talkin' about it all the time.
lines.zh: : 我跟自己说过要往前看了。你要是老提，我真的很难做到。

lines.en: : That makes sense. But you see what I’m saying, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 有道理。但你明白我的意思吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Now, about Chinami-
lines.zh: : 不明白。行了，说说 Chinami——

lines.en: Well, I guess I can’t blame her for wanting to change the topic.
lines.zh: 好吧，我想我也不能怪她想换话题。

lines.en: Getting her to admit that she’s starting to hate me less with each passing day will have to wait for some other time.
lines.zh: 想让她承认自己正一天比一天不那么恨我，得等以后了。

lines.en: Unless I manage to ruin that somehow, which I don’t think is ever entirely out of the question.
lines.zh: 除非我又不小心搞砸了——而这从来都不是完全不可能的事。

lines.en: I probably shouldn’t ask her to lick the ice cream anymore.
lines.zh: 我大概不该再叫她舔冰淇淋了。

lines.en: I think that would be a good start.
lines.zh: 我觉得这会是个好的开始。

lines.en: : Chinami...seems weirdly attached to you. And I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : Chinami……不知怎么特别黏你。我搞不懂。

lines.en: : Like, she normally listens to me about everything. But no matter how much mean shit I say about you, she keeps saying that you’re nice and that you’re her new dad or some shit.
lines.zh: : 她平时什么都听我的。可不管我说你多少难听的话，她还是一直说你人很好，还说你是她的“新爸爸”什么的。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends17
: You’re not fuckin’ paying her or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在给她钱什么的吧？

lines.en: : I know Chika won’t let her buy shit on the phone, so if you’re giving her money for micro-whatevers, that’s playing dirty.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Chika 不让她用手机买东西，所以要是你给她钱买什么微交易，那可就太下作了。

lines.en: Nope. Just paying for her entire phone bill.
lines.zh: 没有。只是替她付了整份手机账单。

lines.en: Yours too.
lines.zh: 你的也是。

lines.en: Surprise.
lines.zh: 惊喜吧。

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我没有。

lines.en: : I don’t really get it either.
lines.zh: : 我也真的搞不懂。

lines.en: : I’m normally horrible with kids.
lines.zh: : 我平时很不擅长应付小孩。

lines.en: : Chinami ain’t some normal kid. She’s dealing with shit no one her age should ever have to deal with.
lines.zh: : Chinami 可不是什么普通小孩。她在应付一些她那个年纪根本不该碰上的事。

lines.en: : Runaway dad. Dead mom. Can’t even go outside because she might get sick and die.
lines.zh: : 爸跑了。妈死了。连门都出不了，因为搞不好会生病死掉。

lines.en: : She’s worse off than even I was and I popped out of a fuckin’ heroin junkie into a Yakuza den.
lines.zh: : 她比我那时候还惨，而我可是从一个海洛因瘾君子肚子里掉出来、落在黑帮窝里的。

lines.en: : She’s weirdly strong and crazy smart, even if she says her own name all the fuckin' time.
lines.zh: : 她坚强得离谱，也聪明得离谱，尽管她老把自己的名字挂在嘴边。

lines.en: : The one thing I don’t get, though, is you.
lines.zh: : 不过我唯一搞不懂的，是你。

lines.en: : Like, why?
lines.zh: : 就是，为什么？

lines.en: : Again, I have no idea. Sometimes people just like people even though they shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我不知道。有时候人们就是会喜欢上不该喜欢的人。

lines.en: : Sounds like you’re talking about the entire fucking class when you put it like that.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，听起来像是在说我们整个班。

lines.en: : Maybe I am?
lines.zh: : 也许是吧？

lines.en: : It’s not like I understand why everyone gravitates toward me. They just do.
lines.zh: : 我又不是不懂为什么大家都往我身边凑。他们就是会。

lines.en: : Not {i}everyone{/i}, chief. Let me remind you that I hate your fucking guts.
lines.zh: : 不是“{i}所有人{/i}”，老大。我提醒你一下，我他妈恨你恨到骨子里。

lines.en: : And that I think Chika and Chinami are both insane for even letting you into their house.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得 Chika 和 Chinami 都疯了，居然还让你进她们家门。

lines.en: : You know there’s probably something you could tell them if you really wanted to stop that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道，要是你真想阻止，你大可以跟她们说点什么吧？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends18
: Yeah but I doubt they’d even fuckin’ believe me at this point.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过我怀疑这会儿她们根本不会信我。

lines.en: : I already tried telling Chika all the weird shit about the detentions you used to give me and she basically called me a liar right to my face.
lines.zh: : 我之前就跟 Chika 说过你以前留我关禁闭的那些破事，她基本是当着我的面说我在撒谎。

lines.en: : And why the fuck would anyone else believe anything I tell them when they all like you more than me?
lines.zh: : 再说了，他们喜欢你都胜过喜欢我，谁还会相信我说的话？

lines.en: : They’ll just think I’m trying to damage your reputation or some shit. I know how this game works.
lines.zh: : 他们只会觉得我是想败坏你的名声什么的。这游戏规则我懂。

lines.en: : Just get them to like you then.
lines.zh: : 那就让他们喜欢上你呗。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends19
: Why? So I can tell them we made out once and that I started crying?
lines.zh: : 为什么？好让我告诉他们我们接过吻、我还哭了？

lines.en: : So you could feel less lonely.
lines.zh: : 好让你不那么孤单。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends20
: I’m not lonely! I like being alone!
lines.zh: : 我不孤单！我喜欢一个人待着！

lines.en: : It suits me!
lines.zh: : 这很适合我！

lines.en: : Isn’t that because you make it suit you?
lines.zh: : 那是不是因为你自己把它变得适合了？

lines.en: : And what does that even mean? {i}Being lonely suits you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说，{i}“孤单适合你”{/i}到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : It {i}means{/i} that I can get by on my own.
lines.zh: : {i}“意思”{/i}就是我自己能过得下去。

lines.en: : And that I don’t need people who are dumb enough to fall for their fucking [high_school] teacher giving me life advice and shit.
lines.zh: : 我不需要那种蠢到会爱上自己[high_school]老师的人来给我人生建议什么的。

lines.en: : You don’t need to listen to anyone’s advice. But having people around isn’t a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 你不需要听任何人的建议。但身边有人并不是坏事。

lines.en: : Also, Chika has definitely fallen for me and you’re with her all the time.
lines.zh: : 再说，Chika 确实已经爱上我了，而你又整天跟她在一起。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends21
: Yeah, so I know firsthand how fucking annoying it is to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 对啊，所以我最清楚那有多他妈烦人。

lines.en: : Don’t know what this sudden fascination is with getting me to “change” or whatever, but just fucking stop. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你最近这股想让我“改变”的执念是怎么回事，但你他妈给我停下。好吗？

lines.en: : Do you want me to stop helping you get a job as well?
lines.zh: : 那你也想让我别再帮你找工作了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Do whatever the fuck you want.
lines.zh: : 随便。你他妈爱怎样怎样。

lines.en: : I want to keep helping you.
lines.zh: : 我想继续帮你。

lines.en: : Well, fucking help me then. What are you even getting at?
lines.zh: : 那你他妈就帮啊。你到底想说什么？

lines.en: : Just trying to figure out what it is you really want.
lines.zh: : 我只是想弄清楚你真正想要的是什么。

lines.en: : I want to be left alone. I’ve told you that a million times.
lines.zh: : 我想一个人待着。这话我说过一百万遍了。

lines.en: : Do you really, though?
lines.zh: : 可你真的想吗？

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends22
: Yup.
: Also, my ice cream is starting to melt. Can you leave now?
lines.zh: : 还有，我的冰淇淋开始化了。你现在能走了吗？

lines.en: : One lick and I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 舔一口我就走。

lines.en: : What kind of fucking weird fetish even is this?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么鬼变态癖好？

lines.en: : I’ve just gotta see it. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我就是得看一眼。抱歉。

lines.en: : And you promise you’ll leave?
lines.zh: : 你保证你会走？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 保证。

lines.en: : And I don’t mean like, you’ll leave in ten minutes. You need to leave as soon as I do it.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是过十分钟再走。我做完你就得立刻走。

lines.en: : I understand. I accept these conditions.
lines.zh: : 我明白。我接受这些条件。

lines.en: scene wherethesidewalkends23
scene wherethesidewalkends24
scene wherethesidewalkends25
: {i}*Lick*{/i}
scene wherethesidewalkends26
: Wow.
: See ya.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Thank you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Yumi。

lines.en: : I will remember this.
lines.zh: : 我会记住这一刻的。

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 求你别。

lines.en: scene black
There is a place where the sidewalk ends.
lines.zh: 有一个地方，人行道的尽头。

lines.en: I can’t guarantee that Yumi or I will ever find it.
lines.zh: 我不能保证 Yumi 或者我有朝一日会找到它。

lines.en: But it’s there.
lines.zh: 但它就在那儿。

lines.en: And if the two of us happen to find it at the exact same time-
lines.zh: 而要是我们两个碰巧同时找到了它——

lines.en: We will either jump together-
lines.zh: 我们要么一起跳下去——

lines.en: Or one of us will give the other a push.
lines.zh: 要么其中一个把另一个推下去。

lines.en: I don’t want to die.
lines.zh: 我不想死。
